authentication.comparison: The entered user id and password are converted with FUNCTION UPPER-CASE, then SEC-USR-PWD is compared equal to WS-USER-PWD.
authentication.lockout: No lockout counter or attempt limit is coded in the sign-on EVALUATE.

roles.enforcement: After a matching password, COSGN00C transfers to COADM01C.
A non-admin match transfers to COMEN01C. On that menu, a user-type U session is refused an option whose table user type is A.

admin_menu_guard.finding: COADM01C does not test CDEMO-USRTYP-ADMIN. The admin menu is reached by the sign-on transfer.

empty_commarea.finding: When EIBCALEN is 0, COCRDLIC sets CDEMO-USRTYP-USER to true before continuing.

password_maintenance.statement: A new user password is stored by moving the screen field PASSWDI to SEC-USR-PWD. That paragraph does not call FUNCTION UPPER-CASE.
When the screen password differs from SEC-USR-PWD, the screen value replaces the stored password.

platform.scope: Transaction definitions in the base CSD, the VSAM-MQ CSD, the DB2 CSD, and the authorization CSD.

platform.definition: GRANT DBADM ON DATABASE CARDDEMO TO PUBLIC; GRANT USE OF TABLESPACE CARDDEMO.CARDSPC1 TO PUBLIC; GRANT DELETE, INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE on CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE and CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY TO PUBLIC.
RACFCMDS runs IKJEFT01. SYSIN contains RALT GCICSTRN CARD ADDMEM(CT02) and CONNECT of one user to GROUP(M2APPDEV). No ADDUSER, PERMIT, or RDEFINE of a data-set profile is in that job.
The point-in-time LISTCAT shows RACF----------------(NO) on listed clusters. Example line 43. This is the catalog as of 09/01/22, not a RACF rule.
No MQ set-authority command was found.

sensitive.protection: Compared as an equal 8-byte value after the sign-on input is upper-cased. The BMS password field is dark. No encryption routine is called in the sign-on paragraph.
The job SYSIN contains a user id and a password. Those values are not copied into this catalog.

observations: Sign-on stores the user type from SEC-USR-TYPE into CDEMO-USER-TYPE and branches only on the value A.
The user menu refuses an option marked A when the commarea user type is U, with message 'No access - Admin Only option... '.
DB2 privileges in DB2CREAT.ctl are granted to PUBLIC.
CICS resource and command security are set to NO on the transaction definitions that were read.
